title: 光学材料：折射、吸收与反射

author_source: project/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/04_4. More on Properties of Light/src.py

points.K1: 从理论走进光学实验室
points.K8: 辐照度：功率挤在多大面积上
points.K14: 窗口有两个面，反射更多
points.K15: 课后动手：反射和滤光片

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学平台旁，桌上摆着透镜、棱镜和窗口片，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an optical table with a lens, a prism and a flat window on it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲光学材料的折射、吸收和反射。
overlay: 光学材料：折射、吸收与反射

shots.scene: 透镜、彩虹棱镜、渐暗的玻璃块、反光镜面四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a lens, a prism splitting light into a rainbow, a glass block with a fading beam, and a shiny reflecting surface. No people.
shots.narration: 光走进材料，会变慢、变弱、被反射。

shots.scene: 阿杰面对一盒透镜、棱镜和窗口片，不知道选哪个
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at an open box full of lenses, prisms and glass windows, unsure which one to pick.
shots.narration: 阿杰要选一块窗口片，却犯了难。

shots.scene: 他发现窗口片表面映出淡淡的反光
shots.prompt_en: He holds a clear glass window up to the light and notices a faint reflection on its surface.
shots.narration: 玻璃明明透明，怎么还会反光？

shots.scene: 小研拿出一张空白曲线图递给他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a blank chart with a curve icon.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄懂材料怎么对待光。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这一课，讲光学材料的性质。

shots.section_title: 从理论走进光学实验室
shots.scene: 欣欣翻过一本空白书，前三页画着波浪、光点和原子图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips through a blank book whose first pages show a wave icon, a glowing dot icon and an atom icon.
shots.narration: 前几课，我们打好了光的基础。
overlay: 从理论走进光学实验室

shots.section_title: 从理论走进光学实验室
shots.scene: 一条路从书本通向光学实验室大门
shots.prompt_en: A path leads from an open book to the door of an optics lab. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课，开始走进光学实验室。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three blank cards floating in the air.
shots.narration: 这一课有三个目标。

shots.scene: 三张卡片依次打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards each getting a green check mark one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂材料，选对材料，认识镀膜。

shots.scene: 光学平台上摆满各种元件：金属支架、黑色挡板、透镜、棱镜
shots.prompt_en: An optical table filled with many parts: metal mounts, black panels, lenses and prisms. No people.
shots.narration: 光学实验室里，材料五花八门。

shots.scene: 左边不透光的金属块，右边透光的玻璃块
shots.prompt_en: A solid metal block that light cannot pass on the left, and a clear glass block that light passes through on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 大体分两类：不透明和透明。

shots.scene: 透镜、棱镜、窗口片三件透明元件并排
shots.prompt_en: Three clear optical parts side by side: a lens, a prism and a flat window. No people.
shots.narration: 透镜、棱镜、窗口片都是透明材料。

shots.scene: 光穿过窗口片几乎不减弱，表面只有微弱反光
shots.prompt_en: A beam passes through a window with almost no fading and only a faint reflection on the surface. No people.
shots.narration: 好材料：吸收少，反射少。

shots.scene: 表面光洁、内部无气泡的玻璃，对比有气泡划痕的玻璃被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A smooth flawless glass piece next to a scratched glass piece full of bubbles crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 折射率较小，内部缺陷少，表面磨得好。

shots.scene: 强光束打在元件上，元件完好无损
shots.prompt_en: A strong beam hits an optical part and the part stays undamaged, with a small shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能经得住激光，不被打坏。

shots.scene: 温度计和水汽图标围着元件，元件依旧透亮
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon and water vapor icons around an optical part that stays clear. No people.
shots.narration: 受热、受潮，性能也不变差。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两条跑道：真空里的光点跑得快，玻璃里的光点跑得慢
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two lanes: a glowing dot running fast in empty space and another running slower inside glass.
shots.narration: 光进了玻璃，就会跑慢。

shots.scene: 两个计时表，一快一慢，中间是除号图标
shots.prompt_en: Two stopwatches, one fast and one slow, with a simple divide symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 慢了多少倍，就是折射率。

shots.scene: 真空的跑道上写着一个大大的勾，其他材料的跑道都更长
shots.prompt_en: The empty-space lane has a green check as the baseline, and lanes for other materials look longer. No people.
shots.narration: 真空最快，其他材料都比它大。

shots.scene: 红、绿、紫三个光点穿过玻璃，紫色的最慢
shots.prompt_en: Red, green and violet dots move through glass; the violet one moves slowest. No people.
shots.narration: 不同颜色，折射率还不一样。

shots.scene: 三条略向下倾斜的曲线，紫端高、红端低
shots.prompt_en: Three gently falling curves on a blank chart, higher at the violet end and lower at the red end. No people.
shots.narration: 紫光折射率大，红光小。

shots.scene: 三条曲线旁分别是普通玻璃、透明塑料、石英三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an ordinary glass block, a clear plastic sheet and a quartz crystal beside the three curves. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃、塑料、石英，各有各的曲线。

shots.scene: 白光射入棱镜，散成彩虹
shots.prompt_en: White light enters a prism and spreads out into a rainbow. No people.
shots.narration: 差别虽小，棱镜就能把白光分开。

shots.scene: 光束射到一块平板玻璃上
shots.prompt_en: A light beam heading onto a flat glass plate. No people.
shots.narration: 光照到透明材料上，会分成几路。

shots.scene: 四个箭头：反射回、被吃掉、向四周散、穿过去
shots.prompt_en: Four arrows from the glass plate: one bouncing back, one fading inside, one spraying sideways, one going through. No people.
shots.narration: 反射、吸收、散射，剩下的透射。

shots.scene: 厚玻璃、薄玻璃、不同颜色光三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thick glass block, a thin glass sheet and beams of different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收多少，看厚度、材料和波长。

shots.section_title: 辐照度：功率挤在多大面积上
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着两个手电，一个光斑大，一个光斑小而亮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds two flashlights; one makes a wide soft spot, the other a small bright spot on a wall.
shots.narration: 同样的功率，光斑大小不一样。
overlay: 辐照度：功率挤在多大面积上

shots.section_title: 辐照度：功率挤在多大面积上
shots.scene: 同样一杯水，倒在大盘子里和小杯里的对比
shots.prompt_en: The same amount of water poured into a wide plate and into a narrow cup, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 功率除以面积，就是辐照度。

shots.section_title: 辐照度：功率挤在多大面积上
shots.scene: 细光束在纸上烫出小黑点，粗光束只是照亮
shots.prompt_en: A thin beam leaves a small dark mark on a sheet of paper while a wide beam only lights it up. No people.
shots.narration: 细光束更集中，作用强得多。

shots.section_title: 辐照度：功率挤在多大面积上
shots.scene: 小研举着一张空白卡片，上面画着细光束图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a blank card showing a thin beam icon.
shots.narration: 所以要看辐照度，不能只看功率。

shots.scene: 光束穿过一块厚玻璃，越往后越暗
shots.prompt_en: A beam passes through a thick glass block and gets dimmer and dimmer along the way. No people.
shots.narration: 光在材料里，一路走一路变弱。

shots.scene: 三块从薄到厚的玻璃，透出的光依次变暗
shots.prompt_en: Three glass pieces from thin to thick, each letting out a dimmer beam. No people.
shots.narration: 材料越厚，透过越少。

shots.scene: 浅色玻璃和深色玻璃，深色透出的光更暗
shots.prompt_en: A pale glass and a dark tinted glass of the same thickness; much less light comes out of the dark one. No people.
shots.narration: 材料越吸光，衰减越快。

shots.scene: 进来的光和出去的光两个光柱比高低
shots.prompt_en: Two light columns compared: the incoming light column and a shorter outgoing light column. No people.
shots.narration: 出去的光占进来的几成，叫透射率。

shots.scene: 吸收程度随材料和颜色变化的两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: different material blocks, and beams of different colors, each with a different fading level. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收强弱，看材料，也看颜色。

shots.scene: 彩虹光几乎全部穿过一块光学玻璃
shots.prompt_en: A rainbow beam passes almost completely through a piece of optical glass. No people.
shots.narration: 多数光学玻璃，可见光几乎全透。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张空白透射曲线图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank transmission chart with a few curves.
shots.narration: 不同材料，透过的波段不同。

shots.scene: 石英元件让紫色光通过，普通玻璃挡住紫外
shots.prompt_en: A quartz part lets violet and ultraviolet light pass, while an ordinary glass part blocks the ultraviolet. No people.
shots.narration: 做紫外实验，要选石英类材料。

shots.scene: 红外长波射到玻璃上被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Long infrared waves hit an ordinary glass plate and are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 到了较长的红外，玻璃就不透了。

shots.scene: 一种材料让红外通过、挡住可见光的示意
shots.prompt_en: An optical part lets infrared waves through while blocking visible colored light. No people.
shots.narration: 只透红外的材料，能做红外元件。

shots.scene: 小研拿着元件对照空白曲线图挑选
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds an optical part and compares it with a blank chart while choosing.
shots.narration: 按工作波段查曲线，再选元件。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格，左列是几种晶体图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with icons of several crystals in the left column. No people.
shots.narration: 红外材料，可以查性质表。

shots.scene: 表格各列：波段、折射率、备注图标
shots.prompt_en: Table columns shown as icons: a wavelength range bar, a bending light icon and a note icon. No people.
shots.narration: 波段、折射率、注意事项一目了然。

shots.scene: 一块晶体遇水变模糊，一块晶体沿裂纹裂开
shots.prompt_en: One crystal turning cloudy near water droplets, and another crystal splitting along a crack line. No people.
shots.narration: 有的怕潮，有的易裂，要小心。

shots.scene: 一块厚实的晶体窗口和一个钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy crystal window next to a money bag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的耐高功率，但价格贵。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着空气和玻璃的分界线，光射过来一小部分弹回
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the boundary between air and glass where a small part of a beam bounces back.
shots.narration: 两种材料折射率不同，界面就反射。

shots.scene: 垂直入射的光束，大部分进入玻璃，一小部分返回
shots.prompt_en: A beam hits glass straight on; most goes in and a small part comes back. No people.
shots.narration: 空气到玻璃，约有百分之四反射回去。

shots.scene: 进入玻璃的光在里面慢慢变弱
shots.prompt_en: The beam that entered the glass slowly fades as it travels inside. No people.
shots.narration: 其余约百分之九十六进玻璃，再被吸收。

shots.section_title: 窗口有两个面，反射更多
shots.scene: 一块有前后两面的窗口片，光在两面之间来回弹
shots.prompt_en: A flat window with a front face and a back face; light bounces back and forth between the two faces. No people.
shots.narration: 窗口片有前后两个面。
overlay: 窗口有两个面，反射更多

shots.section_title: 窗口有两个面，反射更多
shots.scene: 每弹一次，就有一束弱光从前面跑出来
shots.prompt_en: Each bounce lets one weaker beam escape from the front face, forming a row of parallel beams. No people.
shots.narration: 光在里面来回弹，一次漏出一束。

shots.section_title: 窗口有两个面，反射更多
shots.scene: 多束反射光叠在一起比单次反射更粗
shots.prompt_en: Several reflected beams add up into a thicker bundle compared with a single reflection. No people.
shots.narration: 加起来，总反射比一个面更多。

shots.section_title: 窗口有两个面，反射更多
shots.scene: 旧算法卡片被打叉，换上新卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank card crossed out with a red X is replaced by a new blank card. No people.
shots.narration: 算总反射，要把多次反射都算上。

shots.section_title: 课后动手：反射和滤光片
shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑上拖动滑块，屏幕上光线反射角度变化
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drags a slider on a computer; on the screen a simple light ray changes its reflection angle.
shots.narration: 课后可用小程序，调角度看反射。
overlay: 课后动手：反射和滤光片

shots.section_title: 课后动手：反射和滤光片
shots.scene: 屏幕上一条只让中间一段颜色通过的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen shows a simple curve that lets only a middle band of colors pass. No people.
shots.narration: 也能调滤光片，看哪段颜色透过。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一片彩色滤光片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a colored filter disc.
shots.narration: 下一讲，我们讲滤光片和光学元件。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现棱镜和慢跑的光点图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a prism and a slowly running glowing dot.
shots.narration: 光进材料变慢，颜色不同折射不同。

shots.scene: 细光束和越来越暗的玻璃块图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thin intense beam and a glass block with a fading beam. No people.
shots.narration: 细光束更强，材料越厚透过越少。

shots.scene: 透射曲线和晶体表格图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a transmission chart and a crystal table. No people.
shots.narration: 按工作波段，查曲线、查表选材。

shots.scene: 窗口片前后两面射出多束反射光
shots.prompt_en: Several weak reflected beams come out of a two-faced glass window. No people.
shots.narration: 每个面都反射，窗口总反射更多。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一片彩色滤光片在光学平台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a colored filter and waves goodbye beside a tidy optical table.
shots.narration: 下一讲讲滤光片，下次见！
